items.q: Single file Indian file infiltration with absent E cadherin defines which breast cancer?
items.exp: Loss of E cadherin adhesion lets lobular cancer cells infiltrate singly in Indian files, often bilateral and mammographically occult with unusual serosal metastases.
r: Incorrect. Ductal cancers form cohesive desmoplastic masses.
Correct. Indian files plus E cadherin loss mean lobular.
Incorrect. Tubular cancers form angulated glands with good prognosis.
Incorrect. Mucinous cancers float clusters in mucin pools.
items.kp: Discohesive single files equal lobular carcinoma.

items.q: Persistent unilateral nipple eczema failing steroid cream should be biopsied for what?
items.exp: Paget disease spreads malignant cells within nipple epidermis mimicking eczema but never healing, usually overlying ductal carcinoma in situ or invasive cancer needing full staging.
r: Incorrect. Grading eczema delays cancer diagnosis dangerously.
Correct. Non healing nipple eczema means Paget until proven otherwise.
Incorrect. Fibrocystic change affects parenchyma, not nipple skin like this.
Incorrect. Ectasia causes discharge and retraction in older smokers.
items.kp: Nipple eczema that stays is cancer until biopsy says no.

items.q: A rubbery, highly mobile painless lump in a 22 year old is most likely what?
items.exp: Fibroadenomas are benign biphasic tumours of young women, rubbery and mobile (breast mouse) under the examining hand. Phyllodes occurs older and grows rapidly with leaf like architecture.
r: Incorrect. Phyllodes favours older women with fast growth.
Correct. Young mobile rubbery lump means fibroadenoma.
Incorrect. Cancer feels hard, irregular and fixed by comparison.
Incorrect. Abscess is painful, hot and fluctuant.
items.kp: Breast mouse in a young woman: fibroadenoma.

items.q: Triple negative breast cancer lacks which three targets?
items.exp: Triple negative cancers express neither oestrogen nor progesterone receptors nor HER2 amplification, excluding endocrine and anti HER2 therapy and relying on chemotherapy based regimens.
r: Correct. ER, PR and HER2 negativity defines triple negative.
Incorrect. BRCA and TP53 are mutations, not the defining receptor panel.
Incorrect. Cytokeratin proves epithelial origin, not a drug target here.
Incorrect. ALK belongs to lung cancer profiling.
items.kp: Triple negative counts receptors: ER, PR, HER2 all absent.

items.q: Red, swollen, warm breast with peau d orange and no discrete mass most likely is what?
o: Mastitis in a non lactating woman
Inflammatory breast carcinoma with dermal lymphatic invasion
items.exp: Inflammatory carcinoma plugs dermal lymphatics causing rapid red oedematous peau d orange change, staged as locally advanced (T4d) even without a palpable mass. Non lactating mastitis unresponsive to antibiotics needs the same suspicion.
r: Incorrect. Mastitis outside lactation that persists must exclude cancer.
Correct. Peau d orange means inflammatory carcinoma until disproven.
Incorrect. Cellulitis lacks peau d orange lymphatic pattern and course.
Incorrect. Fibrocystic change is cyclical lumpiness without this skin.
items.kp: Peau d orange breast is advanced cancer behaviour, whatever the size.

items.q: Comedo DCIS on mammography appears typically as what prompting biopsy?
o: Clustered pleomorphic calcifications in ductal distribution
items.exp: Ductal carcinoma in situ calcifies necrotic debris in branching ductal (linear) distributions detected mammographically before any mass exists. Comedo necrosis marks higher grade disease.
r: Incorrect. Masses suggest invasive disease more.
Correct. Branching calcifications reveal DCIS.
Incorrect. Cysts are benign fluid structures.
Incorrect. Oil cysts follow trauma fat necrosis benignly.
items.kp: Mammogram calcifications in lines mean biopsy for DCIS.

items.q: Which benign lesion is a precursor with raised cancer risk through atypical hyperplasia?
items.exp: Atypical ductal or lobular hyperplasia multiplies later cancer risk in either breast and may upgrade on excision, guiding surveillance and risk reduction discussions.
r: Incorrect. Simple cysts carry no meaningful risk rise.
Correct. Atypical hyperplasia raises bilateral risk.
Incorrect. Apocrine change is benign fibrocystic component.
Incorrect. Mastitis is inflammatory, not premalignant.
items.kp: Atypia in breast tissue raises risk in both breasts.

items.q: HER2 positive breast cancer benefits from which targeted drug class exemplified by trastuzumab?
items.exp: Amplified HER2 drives growth blocked by trastuzumab based anti HER2 therapy, transforming this subtype prognosis. Cardiac monitoring accompanies treatment for cardiomyopathy risk.
r: Incorrect. Endocrine therapy needs hormone receptors.
Correct. Trastuzumab targets HER2 amplification.
Incorrect. PARP inhibitors serve BRCA mutated cancers selectively.
Incorrect. CDK inhibitors partner endocrine therapy in receptor positive disease.
items.kp: HER2 amplified means anti HER2 therapy plus cardiac vigilance.

items.q: Leaf like clefts with stromal overgrowth in a fast growing large breast mass indicate what?
items.exp: Phyllodes tumours exaggerate fibroadenoma architecture into leaf like fronds with stromal cellularity, recurring locally if shelled out and rarely metastasising when malignant, so wide margins matter.
r: Incorrect. Fibroadenoma lacks leaf fronds and stromal overgrowth.
Correct. Leaf like stromal tumour means phyllodes.
Incorrect. Lobular cancer infiltrates in single files.
Incorrect. DCIS stays inside ducts without stromal fronds.
items.kp: Leaf like breast tumour: excise phyllodes widely.

items.q: Sentinel lymph node biopsy in breast cancer serves what purpose?
o: Stages the axilla sampling first draining nodes to spare full clearance morbidity
items.exp: Sentinel biopsy samples the first draining nodes; if clear, full axillary clearance and its lymphoedema risk are avoided without losing staging accuracy in suitable early cancers.
r: Incorrect. Imaging remains essential for staging.
Correct. Sentinel sampling stages axilla with less morbidity.
Incorrect. It has no distant disease treatment role.
Incorrect. Grade comes from tumour histology, not nodes.
items.kp: Sentinel node negative means spare the axilla.
